crossRefs.note: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
“Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened…
As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the…
“Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is…
For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted…
For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast…
You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did…
Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her…

translations.web: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
translations.bsb: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
translations.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
translations.asv: But now ye glory in your vauntings: all such glorying is evil.
